revisionDesc.change: Finalized - Heilporn's suggestion of Σε̣β̣(εννῦτον) has been added in line 23. The absence of κώμην is no obstacle to this reading.

Vote - AcceptText - After having a good look at l. 23, I think that indeed, the kappa looks more like a beta and, furthermore, that the letter before that looks more like alpha or epsilon rather than omicron. Therefore I would suggest reading here Σε̣β̣( ), scil. for Σε̣β̣(εννῦτον), another Arsinoite village. This has been discussed by mail with Rodney Ast and (through him) with Holger Essler, and both agree with this reading.

Vote - AcceptText - Changes to col. i, line 9 and col. ii lines 8 and 10 seem fine. The proposal for l. 23 is nice and would make good sense given the Arsinoite origin of the document, but there are a couple of things that require consideration. The first concerns paleography: the third letter, which is printed as beta in the edition, does look much like beta; kappas elsewhere are more pointed at the base, although that in [δ]έκα in col. i, 24 bears some resemblance. The second issue is the village name. Neither κώμην (or just the article τὴν) nor Νη/ are written. We might understand κώμην and presume that the abbreviation covered Νήσου (it's omission is not unprecedented, cf. BGU 3 762.1), but the balance of these concerns might encourage us to give ἰς (l. εἰς) <κώμην> Σοκ̣(νοπαίου Νήσου) or ἰς (l. εἰς) Σοκ̣(νοπαίου Νῆσον) as an alternate reading. Next voter?
Submit - Added reading from apparatus of original edition in line 9, own reading in line 23 (cf. commentary), regularisations in col. 2, line 8 (second) and 10.
Commit - Added reading from app. BGU 3 884 in line 9, own suggestion in line 23 (cf. commentary), regularisations in col. 2 line 8 (second) and 10.

Vote - Return-Straight-to-Sender - line 9: --> <:ἵ̣ν̣α̣ μ̣ὴ(?)=BGU 3 884, app.|ed|.3η:>. Line 23: --> <:(Σο̣κ̣(νοπαίου Νήσου))(?)=PN H. Essler (from photo)|ed|(|Σο̣β|):> One might consider, too, only (Σο̣κ̣(νοπαίου)), since νη/ wasn't written, as one might expect it to be, cf. http://papyri.info/ddbdp/bgu;3;762 (line 1).
Submit - Beginning of l. 9: entered Schubart's suggestion from BGU 3 884. End of l. 23: added own suggested reading.
